description: List the items of one inbox conversation — the comments and the replies sent to them — oldest first by default (order=DESC for newest first). Items carry direction (INBOUND | OUTBOUND), state (VISIBLE | HIDDEN | DELETED), author info, and on Instagram comments canPrivateReply (eligibility for send_inbox_private_reply). Replies sent from PostFast appear exactly once — no duplicates when the platform reports them back.

order.description: Sort by comment time. Default ASC (oldest first); DESC for newest first.

name: list_inbox_items
title: List Inbox Items
